methods_quotes.q: Descriptive statistics, including population estimates, weighted prevalence, and 95% confidence intervals (CIs), were calculated to account for the complex study design.
Population estimates for sleep duration categories and each sleep-related difficulty were calculated using NHANES 4-year sample weights
all estimates except age-specific estimates were adjusted by the direct method to the 2000 U.S. population
Prevalence estimates were considered significantly different if the 95% CIs did not overlap.
Analyses were stratified by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and education.
Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population
